opennyai_summary.final__facts:
Because of the callous attitude of the district administration, records relating to the award so prepared, has not been handed over to the petitioner.
The petitioner has claimed that he is entitled for due compensation in respect of his land appertaining to Khata No. 47, Khesra No. 1439, Thana No. 212 measuring total area 50 decimals situated at Mauza- Akhgaon, P.S. Sandesh, Ara at Bhojpur, which the State claims to have acquired way back in the year 1977-78, but, Patna High Court CWJC No.1856 of 2026(2) dt.05-02-2026 till date, the petitioner has not received any compensation amount and action is required to be taken against the authority concerned in accordance with the provision of Section 101 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (RFCTLARR) Act, 2013.

opennyai_summary.final__decision:
Considering the aforesaid information, the District Magistrate-cum-Collector, Ara at Bhojpur, is directed to send the Land Acquisition Officer, Ara at Bhojpur before this Court along with the records relating to the acquisition proceeding relating to land in question, which has forced the petitioner to file the present writ petition.
Re -notify the present application on 12.02.2026, on which date, Land Acquisition Officer, Ara at Bhojpur is required to be present in Court in person along with the aforesaid records.
